methods_quotes.q: Trenching and excavation cases were identified in the CFOI database by using specific codes and keywords
After the initial case selection, a manual review of narratives was performed to select appropriate cases.
Reports of FACE investigations, which provide more detailed information than CFOI, were examined for 1990--2000.
Cases were selected for initial review if the fatal event was coded as an excavation or trenching cave-in
